notes.title: Update 33 - Quality Questing
notes.content:
Bank  

 New verbal command "deposit all" will deposit all gold on your character  
 New verbal command "withdraw all" will withdraw all gold on your character  

Clans  

 Rank 3s may now adjust Clan Bonuses  

Commands  

 /complain and /report will now auto-ignore players  
 /sort will autosort Book of Recall to top of inventory  
 /sortdepot will now stack orbs  

Earth Pents  

 Reduced value of Pentagrams by 29%  

Item Drops  

 Increased all weapon and armor tier drops by (on average) 2 tiers (+20 items now generally drop as WS/AS90 instead of WS/AS70, +15 will generally drop as WS/AS70 instead of WS/AS50, etc)  
 Armor and weapons value is reduced by 65% to compensate for AS/WS increase (gold rate will be the same as before)  

Jobbington  

 Added light to chests  
 Difficulty no longer autoincreases when completed successfully  
 Reduced Brownie point payouts by 10%  
 Reduced Random Orb cost from 5250 to 300  

Live Quests  

 Expanded Live Quest system to allow for more robust questing systems to be used in them, creating a much more flexible Live Quest system which enables far more control and complex quests  

Macro Daemon  

 Macro Daemon will no longer visit you in Lab 4
  
Missions  

 Brownie points required to complete Jobbington missions increased by 10%  

Quest - Aston  
The following quests have had their experience buffed:  

 Loisan's House increased by 71%  
 The Skilver Skull increased by 70%  
 Find Loisan increased by 70%  
 Jeepers Creepers increased by 22%  
 Smuggler Book increased by 35%  
 Contraband increased by 71%  
 Smuggler Leader increased by 45%  
 Underground Park Shrines increased by 33%  
 The Toughest Monster increased by 31%  

Quests - Cameron  
All quests in Cameron that require items will now prompt to turn in automatically as long as you have the item in your inventory or cursor (you can speed up turning in items by saying "complete quest" or "hand it over")  

 Lydia's Potion  
 Find The Magic Item  
 The Second Skull  
 The Third Skull  
 Kill the Foul Magician  
 A Fools Request  
 Mages Gone Berserk  
 The Recipe for Happiness  
 Knightly Troubles  
 The Unwanted Tenants  
 Bear Hunt  

Spawns  

 Added ability to see Clan Members, and Allied Clans, in the dark  
 Removed Light Warrior and Dark Warrior vision in Spawns  

UI  

 Item drop notifications added to Grimroot and Mines  
 Updated help text with new control scheme

notes.title: Update 30 - "A Multi-tude of Updates"
notes.content:
Bone Tower

 Updated Skeletons to no longer drop bodies (bones will now drop directly on floor)
 Updated green dots to be visible in the dark
 Updated bones to now auto-build on pickup


Client

 Added in all current-state updates from Daniel's Client
 Includes fixes for: item description coming into chatbox, incorrect item descriptions, crashing in swamp tileset, tactics display on hover, random text when clicking blue text and more


Commands

 Added /leaveall command to leave all channels
 Added /split command to easily break up SU/GU/orbs/chips in cursor
 Updated /orbs command now contains area and section information
 Updated /sort to prioritize Book of Recall to the first slot, but after Solomon spawn potions
 Updated /sort to build bone bridges
 Updated /sort to autostack chips (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Donation)


Donations

 Added IAC Potion, which removes the need to repeat Ice Army Cave missions. (Example: Completing IAC 1 once will complete it the remaining 2 times.)
 Updated Donation Chips to no longer be trashable


Items

 Updated +1 gear to have a level requirement of 1, instead of 2
 Updated orb sprites to now be labeled with new sprites (New Client only)
 Updated item drops on ground to now be visible in the dark


Jobbington

 Updated green dots to be visible in the dark


Pents

 Updated green dots to be visible in the dark


Rules

 Updated to include new rule against multi-client spawning


Spawn

 Added ability to swap in lobbies
 Updated spawns to only allow one character per Player
 Updated green dots to be visible in the dark

notes.title: Update 28 - "More Spawns, More Military, More Ignore"
notes.content:
Commands

 /ignore now ignores the account for the added Character
 /ignore lists are now shared across all Characters on an account
 /ignore now ignores local (white) chats
 Note: Previous ignores do not carry over into the new system.


Spawns

 Added level 1 Spawn
 Removed green dot from all lobbies
 Added lights to all lobbies


Demon Lords

 Killing all Earth Demon Lords and going back to the Governor will reward you with 100 Military EXP
 Killing all Fire Demon Lords and going back to the Governor will reward you with 200 Military EXP
 Killing all Ice Demon Lords and going back to the Governor will reward you with 400 Military EXP
 Killing all Hell Demon Lords and going back to the Governor will reward you with 500 Military EXP
 Once all Demon Lords have been killed, the Governor will reward you with an additional bonus 500 Military EXP


Grimroot

 When crafting Silver and Gold bars, you no longer need to break down the stack. You may instead use a stack size that is greater than 10k, and 10k will be removed for each time you use the Anvil


Random Dungeons

 When collecting trash, if you have an infinite Steel Pipe, there is now a 50% chance steel bars are converted into gold


Jobbington

 Increased chance to encounter a Boss from 10% to 20%

notes.title: Update 26 - "Viva La Resolution"
notes.content:
Major Client Update!

New resolution options, and TONS of new Client options!

 Dark GUI
 Right-Click Menu
 Action (Icon) Bar, Enter to Chat
 Three Inventory Rows (Smaller Bottom Window)
 Moving Equipment Bar
 Big Health, Mana, Endurance, and Shield Bar
 Sound
 Large Font
 True Full Screen
 Old Mouse Wheel Commands
 Faster Inventory
 Less Command Delay

notes.title: Update 25 - "Blacksmith Bars in; Fire Shield out"
notes.content:
Client

 Added EQ lock button
 Rolled in Daniel's resolution updates (800x600, 1600x1200, 2400x1600)
 

Launcher

 Added search functionality which will search for names, as well as levels
 Added autoupdater to allow for easier deployment instead of Users needing to manually install updates



Server

Aston

 Added Governor Blackmails for levels 50, 100, 150, and 200 to Nibbler


Commands

 Added /ruby, which lists all completed Ruby side missions
 Added /lords, which lists all demon lords


Donations

 Added The Luggage, an item which allows access to your depot from most places
 Prevented ability to buy duplicate donation items when they are in depot
 Prevented sale of Donation items to Vendors


Grimroot

 Added anvil for crafting bars


Ice Army Caves

 Disabled the ability to get regular EXP when using /noexp
 Added confirmation to get regular EXP when using /nolevel


Items

 Added confirmation for using forgetfulness potion
 Prevented quicksell for the following items: Rodney Warped World keys, Stat orbs, Silver and Gold units, and Bronze/Silver/Gold chips
 Added Silver Bars, which lowers the Armor Skill requirement and Armor Value of Armor, and lowers the Weapon Skill requirement and Weapon Value of weapons
 Added Gold Bars, which raises the Armor Skill requirement and Armor Value of Armor, and raises the Weapon Skill requirement and Weapon Value of weapons


Jobbington

 Removed Governor Blackmail as a reward
 Removed bodies and drop gear/keys to floor
 Lobby map update


Mines

 Added new side quest yielding a special mining pickaxe


Missions

 Added new mission type for Jobbington


Sewers

 Added mercy system for items


Spawns
Ring of Reflect Fireball no longer works in Spawns
Added kill/death message to kill channel

Spells
Fire Shield removed

Sprites
Added additional sets to Donation Shop

Swamps
Added way to remove holy from weapons

notes.title: Launcher Updates
notes.content:
Added search functionality which will search for names, as well as levels
Added autoupdater to allow for easier deployment instead of Users needing to manually install updates

notes.title: Update 24 - "Straight Outta Cameron"
notes.content:
Cameron

 The layout of Cameron has been updated! (Secret garden?)
 Skellie 6 added (Non-Quest)

Commands

 /hear or /mission - View remaining count of mission, if applicable
 /spawn - Spawn command is back! Views remaining time in all spawns

Donations

 Added new Sprite cosmetics
 Added new infinite steel pipe for Random Dungeons
 Added new potion to skip Random Dungeons to -5 your current level
 Added new item to set current Random Dungeon to the Continuity shrine the item is used on

Deaths

 Players no longer drop equipped gear, nor Quest items on death

Hell Pents

 Green dot area replaced with new, non-combat, portal area

Items

 Alchemy stones (Earth, Fire, Ice, and Hell) all glow in the dark, allowing Players to see them when there is no light

Mines

 +20% find rate for Silver and Gold units

Professions

 Light Warrior is disabled in Spawn Area
 Dark Warrior is disabled in Spawn Area

Spawn Area

Solomon can now hold multiple conversations at once
